name: Quinoa, Orange & Blueberry Breakfast Salad with Almonds
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine oil, vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter oranges; peel and slice the quarters into wedges.
To serve, divide the quinoa and spinach between plates or bowls; top with orange wedges, blueberries, and sliced almonds. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
author: Mealime
